_about: Behavior profile fitted by seek_bridge.py. Distances in BODY LENGTHS, speeds in BODY LENGTHS PER SECOND. 'targets' = what the cells' group looked like.

fit.time_scale_meaning: 1 s of robot motion ≈ 0.100 s of cell motion
fit.repulsion_note: where cell pairs stop being rarer than chance (pair-distance distribution) (raised to robot minimum)
fit.orientation_note: distance where heading similarity falls halfway to background
fit.attraction_note: ASSUMED (not measurable from one video) — tune live against targets
fit.turning_note: turn rate and noise measured per body length travelled, replayed at robot speed
